name: HCIG Energy Investment Co., Ltd.
summary: HCIG Energy Investment Co., Ltd. invests in, constructs, operates, and manages energy projects based on electricity production in the People's Republic of China. It focuses on coal-fired thermal power generation and heating, as well as nuclear, wind, and hydro power. The company controls and operates installed capacity was 12,476.5 MW, of which thermal power installed capacity 11.77 million kilowatts; and photovoltaic power generation capacity of 706,500 kilowatts. The company was formerly known as Jointo Energy Investment Co., Ltd. Hebei and changed its name to HCIG Energy Investment Co., Ltd. in November 2025.
